purpose: Seven short scenes, one per emotional register, plus a mixed-arc scene. Used to test whether the narration actually changes delivery with the story instead of reading every line the same way.

scenes.title: The locked room
scenes.script: The door was locked from the inside. Nobody had entered for eleven years. And yet, every morning, someone had moved the chair.
scenes.expect: quieter, slower, curious; trailing pauses; no bright exclamation

scenes.title: The record breaks
scenes.script: Four hundred runners. One finish line. And in the final nine seconds, she took the lead. The whole stadium came off its feet!
scenes.expect: energetic, faster, brighter; punchy short sentences

scenes.title: The empty stall
scenes.script: He set out the bread like always. Two loaves, one for her. She had been gone for a year. He still set out two.
scenes.expect: softer, darker, slower; long trailing pauses

scenes.title: The wrong number
scenes.script: The engineer checked the measurement again. Then a third time. The bridge was not supposed to move. It had moved forty centimetres.
scenes.expect: controlled build then an expressive reaction on the final fact

scenes.title: Nine metres down
scenes.script: The rope went slack. Below him, the water was black. He had forty seconds of air left, and the line was caught on something.
scenes.expect: controlled pacing, held back, suspense; no shouting

scenes.title: The official measurement
scenes.script: The town hired a man to measure the town hall. He used his own couch as the unit. The town hall, officially, was eleven couches wide.
scenes.expect: light, wry; a beat of comedic timing before the punchline

scenes.title: What was in the kiln
scenes.script: They had laughed for three years. Then the doors opened. Because what came out was not pottery. It was something nobody had ever seen.
scenes.expect: a held silence before the payoff, then dramatic emphasis

scenes.title: Full arc (the potter, condensed)
scenes.script: Everyone in the village laughed at Sami. While the others chased gold, he chose clay. He shaped a thousand pots, and threw a thousand more away. Then one night, he fired the kiln hotter than ever before. When the doors swung open, the whole village fell silent. Because what came out wasn't just pottery. And the boy they laughed at became the one they remembered.
scenes.expect: delivery must travel comedy -> warm -> sadness -> tension -> hush -> reveal -> resolve
